review.finding: @import fan-out has no total budget: 10 imports per file to depth 3, siblings do not share `seen`, loader.text is neither cached nor counted. ~1100 text fetches of the same file, multi-GB string, tab freeze/OOM from untrusted HTML.
review.suggestion: Cache loader.text per resolved path, dedupe imports document-wide, add a shared byte/fetch budget for text and cap total output size; add a diamond/repeated-import test.

review.finding: MEDIA_TAG (and the pre-existing LINK_TAG) is quadratic on unterminated tags such as `]` also consumes `<`. A hostile 1 MB HTML can freeze the tab; mapTags runs it twice.
review.suggestion: Exclude `<` from the bare class ([^'"<>]) or find tag ends with a linear indexOf scanner; add a perf-bound test.

review.finding: Lexical containment compares the requested (lexical) path with pageDir, a realpath. A page reached through a symlink/junction/subst/8.3 folder gets 403 asset_outside_page_folder for every asset.
review.suggestion: Also accept lexical containment in path.dirname(path.resolve(owner)); keep realpath containment against the real pageDir as the authority; test a symlinked page folder.

review.finding: Broad-folder guard only blocks a filesystem root or the exact home dir; a page in ~/Desktop, ~/Documents, ~/Downloads, C:/Users, /home or /tmp exposes the whole subtree's non-hidden images/css/fonts to a script that can exfiltrate via img-src https:.
review.suggestion: Treat well-known broad folders as too broad (home subfolders Desktop/Documents/Downloads, parents of home, /home, /Users, C:/Users, os.tmpdir(), roots), or restrict depth, or record as accepted risk.

review.finding: srcset is split on every comma (breaks data: candidates and URLs with commas; re-join inserts whitespace). SRC_ATTR/SRCSET_ATTR can match inside another attribute's quoted value (alt=" src=x.png").
review.suggestion: Use the srcset grammar; keep unchanged candidates byte-exact; scan attributes with a quote-respecting tokenizer.

review.finding: `source` stored in `inlined` is never read (dead state).
review.suggestion: Drop it or use it to mark stale.

review.finding: 20 MB cap is checked after the blob is downloaded; up to 40 parallel 5 MB fetches can be buffered (~200 MB transient).
review.suggestion: Check Content-Length first and/or limit concurrency.

review.finding: Test gaps: symlinked page folder, @import diamond/repetition, unterminated-tag timing, comma srcset, ::$DATA/trailing dot/8.3 on the server.

summary: No path-traversal, symlink-escape or Windows-spelling bypass found in decideAssetAccess. Real defects: unbounded @import amplification (high), quadratic MEDIA_TAG/LINK_TAG on unterminated tags (medium), lexical containment vs realpath pageDir breaks symlinked folders (medium), broad-folder guard too narrow (medium); rest low.
